maddeler.e:
تختلبون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِبُونَ (taḵtalibūna) /tax.ta.li.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# تُخْتَلَبُونَ (tuḵtalabūna) /tux.ta.la.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
